newsitem.title: JAPAN: UEDA TANSHI TO ENTER JGB BROKERAGE BUSINESS.
newsitem.headline: UEDA TANSHI TO ENTER JGB BROKERAGE BUSINESS.

text.p: Ueda Tanshi Co Ltd, one of Japan's major money market brokers, is planning to establish a brokerage affiliate with the aim of entering the bond brokerage business in early October, a company official said on Monday.

Ueda Tanshi is in the process of applying for a brokerage license with the Finance Ministry (MOF), and hopes to establish a new brokerage affiliate, tentatively called Ueda Tanshi Securities Co Ltd, in time to begin operations in early October, the official said.

The brokerage affiliate's main business will be to broker inter-dealer domestic bonds, especially Japanese government bond transactions. The brokerage will also be an intermediary for trades of non-stock related over-the-counter options.

The recent establishment of securities affiliates by domestic money market brokers may lead to increased competition in the JGB inter-dealer brokerage business, and this may have a positive effect on the JGB market, the official said.
"It (competition) may help to dig up new demand for JGB transactions and lead to more active JGB trading," he said.
The new company will start with a little less than 20 employess, and start with total capital of about 500 million yen, to be funded entirely by Ueda Tanshi, the official said.
Nihon Tanshi, another major domestic money market broker, established a brokerage affiliate in July for the purpose of entering the JGB inter-dealer brokerage business.
Tokyo Tanshi Co Ltd has recently entered the JGB brokerage business through the establishment of the Tokyo Forex Securities Co Ltd, which began operations on Thursday.
